title: Axway API Gateway Module Lead
description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

**About Sopra Steria**  
Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end-to-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5.6 billion.  
**The world is how we shape it.**

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job description –** **Axway API Management**

* Design, configure, and deploy API proxies, policies, and virtual APIs using **Axway Amplify API Gateway** and **API Manager**
* Develop and manage API lifecycle processes — design, publishing, versioning, deprecation, and retirement
* Implement security policies including OAuth2, JWT, API key management, rate limiting, and threat protection
* Configure and troubleshoot **API Gateway filters, circuits, and policy chains**
* Collaborate with architects and developers to integrate APIs with backend systems using REST, SOAP, JMS, and MQ
* Support API onboarding for internal and external consumers, including partner integrations
* Monitor API performance, conduct root cause analysis, and resolve production incidents (L2/L3 support)
Participate in code reviews, environment promotions (DEV SIT UAT* PROD), and release management
* Prepare technical documentation, API specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger), and runbooks
* Work within Agile/Scrum delivery models and coordinate with onshore/offshore and client stakeholders

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–5 years of total IT experience, with **3+ years dedicated to Axway API Management** (API Gateway, API Manager, API Portal)
* Strong understanding of **API security standards** (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, mTLS)
* Hands-on experience with **REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, XSLT**, and messaging protocols (JMS, MQ)
* **Good hold in CI/CD pipelines** and deployment automation **(Jenkins, Git, Maven/Gradle)**
* Working knowledge of Linux/Unix environments and scripting (Shell/Groovy/Python — good to have)
* Understanding of API governance, versioning strategies, and API monetization concepts
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) is a plus
* Good to have: exposure to **IBM DataPower**, **MuleSoft**, or other API Gateway platforms
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to work directly with client teams

**Soft Skills**

* Strong verbal and written communication for client-facing consulting engagements
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven consulting environment
* Team collaboration and mentoring capability for junior consultants

Total Experience Expected: 04-06 years

**Qualifications**
------------------

BE/ BTECH

--------------------------

At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.

All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

title: Google Cloud Platform Lead

title: Mainframe z/OS System Administrator (Japanese & English)
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**
-------------

As a Japanese-Speaking IBM z/OS System Administrator, you will be responsible for the administration, maintenance, support, and optimization of IBM Mainframe z/OS environments that support mission-critical business applications and services.

You will provide hands-on expertise in z/OS system administration, including system maintenance, upgrades, software installations, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution. You will analyze and resolve complex technical issues, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and contribute to continuous service improvement initiatives to ensure a stable, secure, and high-performing mainframe environment.

This role requires **professional proficiency in both Japanese and English** , enabling effective communication of technical concepts, incidents, changes, and solutions across diverse teams and customer environments.

Success in this role is measured by platform stability, timely incident resolution, successful implementation of changes and upgrades, strong technical ownership, effective customer engagement, and high levels of customer satisfaction.
  
  
**What you will do**

* Configure, maintain, administer, and optimize IBM z/OS environments.
* Provide technical support for z/OS and related components, including JES2, SMP/E, TSO/ISPF, USS, SDSF, JCL, REXX, VSAM, TCP/IP and ISV products.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex system and production issues, including escalated incidents requiring deep technical analysis.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
* Support z/OS maintenance, upgrades, system changes, software installation and configuration.
* Participate in change, incident, problem, release, and configuration management processes.
* Monitor system health, performance, availability, and capacity and take appropriate corrective actions.
* Support Disaster Recovery (DR) planning, testing, and recovery activities.
* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, storage, network, security, automation, and other z/OS support teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Maintain system documentation, operational procedures, configurations, and troubleshooting knowledge.
* Provide technical guidance and support to other team members where required.
* Communicate effectively with customer stakeholders in Japanese and English, including technical discussions, incident coordination, operational updates, and problem resolution.
Ensure activities are completed in accordance with agreed SLAs, security requirements, operational controls, and customer procedures.  

**Your future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscale's that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required skills and experience**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
* 7+ years' experience
* Strong hands-on experience in **IBM z/OS System Administration / System Programming** within enterprise production environments.
* Good working knowledge of **z/OS, JES2, SMP/E, USS, TSO/ISPF, SDSF, JCL, REXX, VSAM, TCP/IP** , and related mainframe technologies.
* Experience in **system maintenance, software installation, upgrades, patching, configuration, and troubleshooting** of z/OS environments.
* Strong understanding of **incident, problem, change, release, and configuration management** processes.
* Proven ability to **analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical and production issues** , including root cause analysis (RCA).
* Experience supporting **high-availability, business-critical mainframe environments** , including Disaster Recovery (DR) and recovery testing.
* Excellent **customer-facing, analytical, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills** with the ability to work across global teams.
* **Professional proficiency in Japanese and English (written and spoken)** , with the ability to conduct technical discussions and effectively engage with Japanese customer stakeholders and global delivery teams.

**Preferred skills and experience**

* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise or regulated customer environments.
* Experience with **IBM mainframe monitoring, automation, performance, capacity, security, or scheduling tools** .
* Working knowledge of **DB2, CICS, IMS, MQ, RACF** , or other related mainframe technologies.
* Experience in mainframe modernization, automation, scripting, or DevOps practices.
* Relevant **IBM, ITIL, Mainframe, Cloud, or DevOps certifications** would be an advantage.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Development Manager
description:
**Job Title - Development Manager**

  

We are now looking for a

  

**Development Manager** to lead a team of developers and to own the technical direction, architecture and quality of the solutions we build. In this role you will combine hands-on technical leadership with people leadership, driving the design, development and continuous improvement of modern applications that create value across KONE. You will also be responsible for driving CI projects, Lean Six Sigma Projects and Innovation programs in the department.

  

You will be the technical anchor of the team - setting coding standards, resolving complex technical and performance issues, and making sure our solutions are scalable, secure and maintainable. We are looking for someone with strong knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform and practical experience applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) in development projects, who can guide the team in adopting these technologies effectively.

  

This role will report to the GEC Development Portfolio Lead.

  

**Requirements for the candidate:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (Computer Science, Mechanical, EEE, Information Technology or a related field).

* 8+ years of work experience in Engineering, including 2+ years in a technical lead or development management role.

* Proven experience leading, mentoring and growing a team of developers in an agile environment.

* Strong knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse and Power Platform connectors).

* Hands-on experience applying AI in development projects - for example generative AI, Copilot / AI-assisted coding, machine learning services or intelligent automation.

* Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, APIs and integration, and cloud platforms (preferably Microsoft Azure).

* Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (e.g. C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python) and familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD practices.

* Experience owning the full software development lifecycle, including performance tuning, security and technical documentation.

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to resolve complex technical and performance issues.

* Excellent communication skills in both spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  

**Key responsibilities:**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of software developers, setting clear goals and supporting their technical and professional growth.

* Own the technical architecture of the solutions, making key design decisions and ensuring they are scalable, secure, performant and maintainable.

* Take an active, hands-on role in coding, code reviews and establishing and enforcing coding standards and best practices.

* Identify, troubleshoot and resolve technical and performance issues across applications and environments.

* Drive the adoption of the Power Platform and AI-based approaches to accelerate delivery and improve solution quality.

* Create and maintain clear technical documentation, including architecture, design and operational guides.

* Plan and manage the delivery of development work, balancing scope, quality and timelines in close collaboration with stakeholders.

* Collaborate with product owners, architects, business stakeholders and other teams to translate requirements into robust technical solutions.

* Ensure solutions follow KONE security, data and compliance standards throughout the development lifecycle.

* Promote continuous improvement, innovation and knowledge sharing within the team and across the wider organization.
  

**Qualities we are looking for:**

* A hands-on technical leader who leads by example and stays close to the code.

* Strong ownership and accountability, with a focus on quality and long-term maintainability.

* A collaborative mindset and the ability to build trust within the team and with stakeholders.

* Curiosity and a passion for learning, especially around emerging technologies such as AI and low-code platforms.

* A structured, pragmatic problem-solver who stays calm under pressure.

* A coaching and mentoring attitude that helps others grow.
  

**Key performance measures:**

* On-time delivery of development commitments.

* Software quality, measured by production defects.

* Application performance and reliability (availability and mean time to resolve incidents).

* Effective adoption of the Power Platform and AI in development, with measurable gains in delivery speed or efficiency.

* Completeness of technical documentation and compliance with KONE security, data and coding standards.

* undefined
  

If you see that you have the experience and qualities to be successful in this role, please submit your application with your CV.

  

**What we offer**

  

As KONE is a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, this is a key role and a great opportunity to build the future cities through improving how people live, work and play in the cities and to help us continue innovating and making magic happen also in the future.

  

You will be working with highly dynamic teams significantly investing time and effort on how we develop services and solutions. You get a chance to work with and participate in further developing products that are used by billions of users in daily basis. Products that are widely recognized by their quality and innovation.

  

Now you have a great opportunity to join a team of skilled colleagues, work in a global environment, and being part of our journey which supports our new strategy!

  

*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*

  

*At KONE, we believe in fair and competitive pay that recognizes performance and supports employee engagement. Our approach covers a comprehensive total rewards package, including both financial and non-financial benefits. We are committed to fostering a culture of fairness, respect, equity, diversity, and inclusion.*

  
  

Read more on *https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html*

title: Lead System Engineer - Google Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Lead System Engineer - Google Forward Deployed Engineer** to design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients, working hands-on with Gemini Enterprise, Google ADK, and the broader Google Workspace ecosystem to deliver scalable, secure, and intelligent multi-agent systems.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy production-grade Multi-Agent Systems and agentic workflows using Gemini Enterprise
* Identify the need for Pro Code vs No Code design based on customer's problem statement and data sources
* Build and deploy custom agents using the ADK and Agent Platform AI Reasoning Engine, and integrate them with Gemini Enterprise
* Build native integrations across the Google Workspace Ecosystem and NotebookLM for grounded enterprise research, document automation, and conversational discovery
* Architect scalable short-term session storage, conversation state persistence, and long-term memory architectures across multi-agent interactions
* Implement end-to-end authentication and authorization perimeters for agents, GCP services, and 3rd-party SaaS integrations using IAM, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and service identities
* Enforce fine-grained ACLs, user/group permission inheritance, and data governance policies to ensure agents strictly adhere to enterprise access boundaries
* Utilize developer tooling including Agent CLI and Antigravity for local rapid prototyping, testing, emulation, distributed tracing, and RCA
* Architect HITL workflows, ensuring seamless Interrupt and Resume patterns between autonomous agents and human experts for critical decision points
* Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines to manage versioned agent deployments, automated testing, and continuous regression evaluations
* Implement advanced reasoning patterns such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT), ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, and Self-Reflection to enhance agent reliability
* Collaborate directly with client engineering and architecture teams to deploy, validate, and operationalize enterprise agentic AI solutions in client environments

**Requirements**

* 7-13 years of overall IT experience, including 4 to 6+ years in software development, cloud solution architecture, and AI engineering, preferably on GCP
* Proficiency in Python with production-level software engineering practices, and expertise in building multi-agent systems using Google ADK or comparable agentic frameworks
* Hands-on experience deploying and customizing Gemini Enterprise, NotebookLM, and integrating with the Google Workspace Ecosystem, including APIs, Add-ons, and Drive/Docs connectors
* Expertise in managing agent session state, short-term context caching, and durable long-term memory backends such as vector databases and relational/NoSQL session stores
* Experience with MCP Connectors to securely integrate core third-party platforms with Gemini Enterprise
* Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols across GCP and 3rd-party SaaS platforms, including IAM, OAuth 2.0, and OIDC
* Knowledge of enterprise ACLs, identity federation, permission trimming, and RBAC across heterogeneous data sources
* Proficiency in developer tooling such as Agent CLI and Antigravity for local simulation, debugging, prompt engineering, and execution graph tracing
* Proven track record of configuring and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines for agent containerization, deployment, and test automation
* Knowledge of AI evaluation methodologies, trajectory analysis, and performing RCA on agent execution failures, tool errors, and prompt regressions
* Proven track record of designing, building, and deploying production AI agents or enterprise GenAI solutions using ADK, Vertex AI, or Gemini
* Hands-on experience in customer-facing technical delivery, solutions engineering, or FDE roles, with familiarity with enterprise Agile SDLC, sprint delivery, and stakeholder management

**Nice to have**

* Experience with inter-agent communication protocols such as MCP and A2A architectures
* Experience integrating agents with Enterprise Knowledge Graphs, structured ontologies, and hybrid vector search systems
* Experience with enterprise data security frameworks such as Sensitive Data Protection and VPC Service Controls

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Lead Business Consultant
description:
**ABOUT TEMENOS**

**Temenos is a global leader in banking technology. Through our market-leading core banking suite and best-in-class composable solutions, we are modernizing the banking industry. Banks of all sizes utilize our adaptable technology – on-premises, in the cloud, or as SaaS – to deliver next-generation services and AI-enhanced experiences that elevate banking for their customers. Our mission is to create a world where people can live their best financial lives.**

  

**VALUES**

  

**Care about transforming the Banking landscape.**

**Commit to being part of an exciting culture and product evolving within the financial industry.**

**Collaborate effectively and proactively with teams within or outside Temenos.**

**Challenge yourself to be ambitious and achieve your individual as well as the company targets.**

  

**Purpose of the Job:**

The Architect (Business) is responsible for coordinating and ensuring successful implementation of their functional area of expertise. The Architect plays the role of interface between the project team and the Client and ensures that all actions are taken to fully satisfy the Client’s functional needs in their business/functional domain. The Architect is also responsible for providing guidance and coaching to less experienced consultants.

When required, Architect shall be required to manage between projects as well as short assignments where required by the manager or consulting manager.

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Recognized internally has specialist on complex functional and business matters.

* Works independently and in collaborative nature. Has completely master business skills required to accomplish the job.

* Provide guidance, coaching and advice to less experienced consultants. Individual with a customer focus who has developed the acumen to cultivate and build lasting customer relations.

* Analyze and validate all Client business requirements and relate them to TEMENOS products capability.

title: Lead I - Product Architect
description:
**Role description**

Data Architect Role Overview The Data Architect will define and own end-to-end data architecture for AI initiatives on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role establishes the data models, platform patterns, governance, and operational standards needed to support ingestion, storage, transformation, serving, and retrieval. Working with business stakeholders, AI specialists, platform engineers, and data engineers, the Data Architect will translate business needs into scalable data foundations and clear architectural direction. Key Responsibilities Data architecture and modeling: Own the architecture across BigQuery, AlloyDB/PostgreSQL, Cloud Storage, and related services. Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling, including domain boundaries, partitioning, indexing, and schema evolution. Pipeline architecture: Establish reference architectures and reusable design patterns for batch and streaming pipelines using Dataflow, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Run. AI-ready data foundations: Design data foundations for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, and hybrid search, including document ingestion, chunking, metadata, embedding pipelines, vector storage using pgvector/ScaNN, and refresh and re-indexing patterns. Large language model integration and evaluation: Define standards for integrating large language model (LLM) APIs, including Vertex AI/Gemini and other providers, into extraction, classification, summarization, and enrichment workflows. Balance quality, cost, latency, and security. Partner with quality assurance (QA) to design evaluation frameworks covering golden datasets, sampling, human review, regression testing, and ongoing measurement of accuracy, consistency, cost, and latency. Governance and data quality: Establish validation, cataloging, and lineage architecture, including tools such as Dataplex. Define standards for personally identifiable information (PII), retention, access controls, and auditability. Reliability and operations: Set service-level agreement (SLA) and service-level objective (SLO) standards, monitoring, ing, idempotency, backfills, failure handling, and incident response. Lead architectural root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. Technology strategy: Evaluate data technologies and platforms, document trade-offs, and guide build-versus-buy decisions, cost optimization, and scalability planning. Support integration with hybrid-cloud and legacy systems, including Azure-based data services where applicable. Cross-functional architecture: Partner with the AI Architect and AI Engineer to support retrieval and agent solutions through sound data design. Work with the Platform Engineer on continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), Infrastructure as Code, and environment standards for data workloads. Technical leadership: Mentor Data Engineers, conduct design and code reviews, and guide complex implementations. Translate business needs and data domains into architectural roadmaps, and produce clear architecture documentation and decision records for technical and non-technical audiences. Qualifications and Technical Expertise Experience designing end-to-end cloud data architectures, with expertise in GCP data services such as BigQuery, AlloyDB/PostgreSQL, and Cloud Storage. Strong conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling skills, including schema evolution, partitioning, indexing, and domain design. Experience defining batch and streaming pipeline patterns using Dataflow, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Run. Experience designing data foundations for RAG, semantic and hybrid search, embedding pipelines, vector storage, and LLM-enabled workflows. Ability to define data quality, governance, lineage, security, retention, and access-control standards, alongside evaluation approaches for AI-enabled data use cases. Knowledge of data-platform reliability, monitoring, failure recovery, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code, with the ability to evaluate scalability, cost, and operational trade-offs. Ability to lead architectural decisions, mentor Data Engineers, collaborate across business and engineering teams, and communicate technical direction through clear documentation and roadmaps. Familiarity with hybrid-cloud and legacy-system integration, including Azure-based data services where applicable.

 **Skills**

AlloyDB, Google Cloud Platform, Data Modeling, Data Governance, LLMs, Vertex AI, Data Privacy, RAG, Observability, Google Cloud Dataflow, BigQuery

title: Software Principal Engineer - System Test & Customer Solutions Validation
description:
**Principal Software Engineer – System Test & Customer Solutions Validation (SONiC AI & Enterprise Networking)**

**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

**Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.**

**What you’ll achieve**

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be responsible for enabling customer adoption of SONiC-based AI and enterprise networking solutions, from POCs and deployment validation to complex escalations. You will work with customers, support, pre-sales, solution architects, and engineering teams on fabric orchestration, deployment readiness, and resolution of customer issues. As a successful candidate, you will be a technically savvy, customer-focused engineer who bridges customers and engineering, resolves critical issues, and accelerates adoption of reliable, scalable, customer-ready SONiC-based networking and AI fabric solutions.

**You will:**

* Serve as the first line of escalation into engineering for support and pre-sales, troubleshooting customer issues and driving workarounds and planned resolutions.
* Define and drive system-level validation strategies for complex SONiC-based AI and enterprise networking solutions, aligned with spec-driven and test-driven development (SDD/TDD), validating customer use cases, POCs, and end-to-end workflows across network infrastructure, fabric orchestration, servers, storage, and telemetry.
* Investigate complex customer-reported issues across SONiC software, networking protocols, platform components, and orchestration systems, including link-level errors and retransmit behavior, closing field escapes through triage, debugging, and closure.
* Provide technical leadership across customer engineering, system test, product management, and software development organizations.
* Drive architectural reviews, identify solution gaps, and influence product engineering roadmaps based on customer deployment requirements, translating customer feedback and field learnings into engineering improvements using Python, SpyTest automation, and AI agents that improve execution efficiency, impact, and value.

**Take the first step towards your dream career**

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

**Essential Requirements**

* Customer and solution experience: working with customers, solution architects, support, and engineering teams on POCs, deployments, and escalations, and system testing complex AI, data center, and enterprise networks, including scale-up, scale-across, scale-out, rack-scale, and fabric-scale environments.
* Networking technologies: VXLAN-EVPN, MLAG, EVPN-MH, ECMP, VRF, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, SRv6, BFD, Layer 2, multicast, RoCE, QoS, DCB (PFC/ECN), lossless Ethernet, link-level retransmission, and enterprise services (DHCP, DNS, NTP, LDAP, RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X).
* Integrated solutions: validation of networking, compute, storage, GPU cluster, and fabric orchestration solutions, including Ansible, Kubernetes integrations, and lifecycle workflows.
* Automation and telemetry: strong Python and test automation skills, with telemetry and northbound interfaces (CLI, REST, gNMI, NETCONF/YANG), traffic generator testing (for example IXIA), and packet analysis.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering in CSE, ECE, EEE, IT, Computer Networks, Cloud Computing, or equivalent.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Experience with SONiC and SpyTest, network test automation, deployment validation, and customer-focused solution demonstrations.
* Experience building or using AI agents and AI-assisted workflows (AI models and tools, for example Claude, Devin, GitHub Copilot) for troubleshooting, solution analysis, automation, and customer issue investigation.

**Who we are**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

description:

You will collaborate with platform, silicon, software, validation, solutions, and customer-facing teams to deliver next-generation Dell Enterprise SONiC capabilities for the high-performance network fabrics powering the Dell AI Factory. You will also apply AI-assisted engineering tools throughout the development lifecycle to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and enhance engineering productivity.

**You will:**

* Own complex networking features end to end, from requirements and architecture through validation and delivery of production-quality Dell Enterprise SONiC software.
* Architect and deliver large-scale data center and AI fabric capabilities on Dell PowerSwitch (800GbE/1.6TbE) platforms, including RoCEv2, congestion management, adaptive routing, SRv6, and dynamic load balancing.
* Troubleshoot complex system, scalability, performance, and customer issues across the control plane, data plane, SAI, and switch ASIC layers.
* Drive fabric automation and lifecycle management using REST APIs, gNMI/OpenConfig, YANG, Python, Ansible, ONIE, and ZTP, and apply Dell AI tools to speed development, testing, and debugging.

title: GenAI Architect
description:

This strategic role is available across **Cognizant’s key delivery locations in India**.

You will lead the **design, adoption, and scaling** of Generative and Agentic AI ecosystems for our most strategic clients.

This role blends **advisory, hands-on solutioning, and practice-building leadership** to ensure AI delivers **tangible, industry-specific business outcomes**.

* **Innovation & Thought Leadership**:Publish **white papers, frameworks, and patents**. Lead **executive roundtables** and contribute to the **Tech Radar**, ensuring the firm shapes the AI conversation in the market.

* **10+ years in IT & architecture**, with clear progression from hands-on engineering (Java/.NET preferred) into enterprise architecture leadership.
* **5+ years in AI/ML**, with **1+ year in Generative & Agentic AI** (LLMs, SLMs, multi-agent orchestration).
* **Model Training Expertise**: Fine-tuning (SFT, RLHF, LoRA/QLoRA), RAG, evaluation pipelines.
* **Hyperscaler Certifications**: Architect-level expertise in **at least two** (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* **MLOps/LLMOps Mastery**: CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, observability, compliance, AI cost governance.
* **CxO Advisory**: Proven experience leading **executive AI strategy discussions** with Fortune 500 clients.
* **Governance Expertise**: Familiar with **AI RMF (NIST), EU AI Act, Responsible AI practices**.
* **People Leadership**: Experience mentoring teams and building **cross-functional AI capability practices**.
* **Ecosystem Influence**: Track record shaping AI initiatives through **partner alliances (hyperscalers, startups, ISVs)**.

* Recognized thought leadership (conferences, panels, media interviews).
* **Industry domain depth** in at least one vertical: **Banking & Payments, Consumer Goods, Energy & Utilities, Healthcare, Insurance, Life Science, Logistics, Manufacturing, Media, Retail, Telecom, Travel & Hospitality**
* Experience with **AgentOps, model evaluation frameworks, and AI observability tooling**.
* **Functional Competencies**
* **Business Acumen**: Identify and execute high-value AI transformations across industries.
* **Consultative Mindset**: Convert **PoCs/PoVs into long-term transformation programs**.
* **Practice Builder**: Mentor, hire, and scale **AI architecture talent pools**.

title: Application Support Analyst
description:

=============================

**API Application Support Analyst**
===================================

With a global team of 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services **connects people** and keeps the global economy running **by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions**. We work **beyond global borders** and push boundaries across **all dimensions of logistics**. You can **leave your mark** shaping the **technology backbone** of the biggest logistics company of the world. All our locations have earned the **#GreatPlaceToWork** certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experience..

**Digitalization. Simply delivered.**  
At IT Services, we are passionate about technology. Our ITS Digital Platforms team is continuously expanding. No matter your level of development proficiency, you can always grow within our diverse environment.

*#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace* #API #Customer #Support

**Grow together in an AI-powered world.**  
Behind every connected experience are opportunities to learn, innovate and grow together. We like to say “**There is no AI without APIs”,** and our team helps customers make those connections count. Join our Group API - API Customer Support team and help customers explore the possibilities of APIs in an increasingly AI-powered world. Our mission is to provide best-in-class support to internal and external customers and business partners throughout the group.

We are looking for a new colleague to join our team to enable, support and guide our customer of Group APIs, which are connecting the entire company together. You will provide reactive and proactive support, review support activities and maintain documentation for ever-improving support quality, collaborate effectively with development teams, and when it comes to our customers, communicating effectively is the key.

You will play a key role in building exceptional relationship with our customers and API product owners, and your proposals on improvements in product roadmaps, processes, service quality, security or API design, that is all welcome in your support league.

Within the API development teams, we are using modern product development approaches, with focus on micro-service architecture, reusability, cloud technologies, and most of all, building products that matter and bring value.

You will be part of a small team of support engineers, promoting best practices guaranteeing quality and long-term sustainability. Your willingness to learn new technologies, coupled with your problem-solving and communication skills, makes you instrumental in our commitment to exceptional API Customer Support experience.

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what we are looking for:**

As an API Customer Support Engineer Analyst, having practical knowledge of API concepts, architecture and correspondent terminology is a huge plus. Very good knowledge of customer support practices & customer service technologies will also be an integral part of this role.

You are a communication & technology aficionado; therefore, you have a good understanding of related technologies and communication styles. You can work independently, prioritize and organize your tasks under time and workload pressure. Working in a multinational environment, you can expect cross-region collaboration with teams around the globe, thus being advanced in spoken and written English will be certainly useful.

**Education & Experience**

* University degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in information technology or a related subject.
* At least 1 year of professional experience in technical customer support, application support, API support or comparable customer-facing IT role.

**Technical Competencies**

* Understanding of Web Technologies and Best Practices (HTTP, URLs, APIs, Security)
* Practical experience with API specification standards (Open API/Swagger)
* Knowledge of cloud, programming languages, automation, or a willingness to acquire these are advantageous.
* Knowledge of the related terminology in the logistics industry, and general knowledge of relevant industry standards, (e.g., EDI) are advantageous.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication of English.
* Excellent analytical skills, problem-solving mindset.
* Customer first mentality and the ability to understand the customer needs.

**Bring your curiosity. Explore what AI can do.** We actively encourage the responsible use of AI tools to explore ideas, accelerate learning, improve documentation and find smarter ways to support our customers. You don’t need to be an AI expert, we value an open mind, a willingness to experiment and the judgment to validate results and protect customer and company information. Grow your skills with us and help turn new possibilities into meaningful everyday improvements.

**An array of benefits for you:**

* Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
* Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
* Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
* In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

**Great Team**  
Hi, my name is Josef Glemba and I’m a team manager. I started my career at DHL IT Services back in 2017, when I took a role as Senior Architect. Gaining more hands-on experience with Cloud, APIs, Architecture and Product Ownership has always fascinated me, so I moved to the Digital Solutions team. In 2024, I moved to a management role, being Manager of API Solutions. Together with the strong support of a multinational & diverse team, we are working on our common ambition: to provide best-in-class APIs.

Looking forward to having you onboard!

title: Mainframe z/OS System Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a Mainframe z/OS System Administrator at Kyndryl, you will manage and support IBM z/OS environments that run mission-critical enterprise workloads for some of the world's largest organizations. You will be responsible for system installation, configuration, maintenance, performance tuning, problem determination, and modernization initiatives. Working closely with infrastructure, storage, security, and application teams, you will ensure the stability, availability, and security of the mainframe platform while driving operational excellence and automation.

  

**What You Will DO**

  

* Manage and administer IBM z/OS systems and associated software products.
* Perform z/OS installations, upgrades, maintenance, and customization activities.
* Monitor system performance, capacity, and availability to ensure optimal operations.
* Troubleshoot and resolve operating system, hardware, and software issues.
* Administer JES2/JES3, TSO/ISPF, SMP/E, HCD, and system utilities.
* Coordinate disaster recovery testing, backup, and business continuity activities.
* Collaborate with application, storage, network, and security teams on infrastructure projects.
Support mainframe modernization and technology transformation initiatives.  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.
  
  
**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 10+ years of experience in Mainframe z/OS System Administration, with extensive hands-on expertise in z/OS installation, configuration, maintenance, and support.
* Skills in applying patches, managing third-party software and ensuring system reliability.
* Hands-on expertise in SYSRES builds, applying PTFs, performing disaster recovery drills and updating license keys.
* Proficiency in product maintenance, upgrades and compatibility checks for z/OS 3.1 and IBM z16 hardware.
* Adept at troubleshooting any system failures, freeze, job abends and performance issues.
* Willingness to provide 24/7 on call support to resolve any system issues.
Experience of working on many migration projects as part of mainframe modernization.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Strong expertise in IBM z/OS architecture design and engineering, including knowledge of Parallel Sysplex and GDPS.
* Experience in mainframe modernization initiatives.
* Experience of supporting the IBM z16 and IBM z17 mainframe systems.
* Exposure to mainframe integration with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Any leadership and mentoring experience will be an added plus.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Lead Consultant(Development)
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

**Role Purpose**

The Migration ETL Developer will play a critical technical role in core banking transformation programmes, focusing on the design, development, and execution of secure, high-quality data migration flows into target systems such as Temenos T24. Using **Informatica PowerCenter and Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC)**, the developer will ensure efficient extraction, transformation, cleansing, and loading of sensitive banking data while maintaining strict compliance with data governance and privacy standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain **robust ETL workflows** using **Informatica (on-premise and cloud - IDMC** ) to support large-scale data migration from heterogeneous source systems.
* Experience in using Powerexchange to access Mainframe source system would be an added advantage.
* Implement scalable data integration jobs covering **extract, transform, cleanse, enrich, and load (ETL/ELT)** processes within both batch and near-real-time environments.
* Conduct **data profiling** to assess source data quality, uncover inconsistencies, duplicates, missing values, and structural anomalies affecting migration integrity.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts and Data Architects to interpret mapping specifications and translate them into executable ETL logic.
* Perform **reconciliation and delta analysis** between source and target systems to validate completeness, accuracy, and consistency of migrated datasets.
* Troubleshoot and resolve performance bottlenecks, connectivity issues, and job failures across development, testing, and production environments.
* Securely handle **client-sensitive data** in line with Swiss banking regulations (FIDLEG, MAR, GDPR) and Julius Baer’s internal data protection policies.
* Document ETL designs, data lineage, interface specifications, and support operational handover post-go-live.
* Participate in agile sprints, code reviews, testing cycles (SIT/UAT), and production cutover activities.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Essential Qualifications**

* Minimum **7-10 years of ETL development experience** in enterprise banking or financial services environments.
* Proven hands-on expertise with **Informatica PowerCenter** and **Informatica Cloud (IDMC preferred)**, including connectors, taskflows, and monitoring dashboards.
* Strong skills in **SQL, PL/SQL**, and relational databases (Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, DB2).
* Demonstrated experience in **data profiling, quality assessment, and reconciliation techniques**.
* Solid understanding of dimensional modelling, metadata management, and CDC (Change Data Capture) concepts.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and version control (Git).

**Preferred Attributes**

* Prior involvement in **core banking migrations** (e.g., to T24, FinSuite, or equivalent).
* Exposure to cloud platforms (**AWS, Azure**) and integration with IDMC.
* Basic knowledge of banking domains: client master, accounts, holdings, transactions, limits.
* Awareness of Swiss regulatory requirements impacting data handling and reporting.

**Technical Accountabilities**

* Deliver high-performance, well-documented ETL solutions meeting functional and non-functional requirements.
* Ensure all data movements are **auditable, reversible, and error-handled** according to bank standards.
* Guarantee successful end-to-end data reconciliation across migration waves.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Informatica

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

Temenos Transact

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

title: Specialist 5 - Functional Systems & Technology
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.  
**Job Summary**

Responsible for providing advanced technical and analytical expertise across complex data, technology, and business environments. Serves as a senior subject matter expert, translating complex and ambiguous business needs into scalable data and technology solutions. Leads cross-functional efforts involving platform capabilities, system integrations, data analysis, solution design, and implementation while evaluating dependencies, risks, controls, and operational impacts. Applies significant independent judgment to solve highly complex problems, influence strategic decisions, and drive reliable, effective business outcomes.

**Job Description**

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact and senior subject matter expert for functional systems and technology platforms within the department.
* Provide advanced subject matter expertise and strategic guidance on platform changes, capabilities, and organizational policies and procedures.
* Conduct comprehensive reviews of complex technical solutions to ensure alignment with business requirements and drive stakeholder agreement on deliverables.
* Ensure the integrity, stability, and reliability of the functional platform by evaluating complex impacts, dependencies, and risks associated with system upgrades.
* Lead relationships with key business and technical stakeholders to define and translate product and technical requirements.
* Perform advanced needs analysis for complex system integrations to meet business objectives.
* Lead training and enablement initiatives for the introduction of new applications, capabilities, or features.
* Evaluate and recommend strategic adoption of new functionalities from vendor releases for the platform.
* Partner closely with the quality assurance team to define, document, and ensure comprehensive testing requirements are addressed.
* Provide expert input on user experience and lead or influence technical deployment activities to ensure platform readiness, stability, and operational effectiveness.
* Consistent exercise of significant independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Lead complex, cross-functional collaboration with product, service, business, data, and technical teams to define data and analytical needs that support business execution and strategic objectives.
* Architect, design, and implement scalable automated processes for data integration, validation, and cleansing across diverse and complex data sources.
* Analyze large, complex, and diverse datasets to identify trends, patterns, risks, and actionable insights that inform business decisions and execution.

title: Senior Workday Integration Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role:**

  

As a Senior Workday Integration Consultant, you will provide technical leadership for the design, development, deployment, and optimization of enterprise Workday integrations across HCM, Financials, and Professional Services Automation (PSA). You will partner with business stakeholders, architects, and technical teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing integration solutions while driving modernization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the Workday landscape.

  

**What Will You Do:**

  

* Lead the design, development, deployment, and optimization of Workday inbound, outbound, and boomerang integrations across HCM, Financials, and PSA domains.
* Conduct integration workshops with business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and design scalable integration solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
* Design and implement integrations using Workday Studio, EIB, Cloud Connectors, Web Services APIs, middleware platforms, and Workday Extend capabilities.
* Manage and support Workday releases, enhancements, upgrades, and integration lifecycle activities while ensuring minimal business disruption.
* Provide advanced technical troubleshooting and resolution for complex integration, data, workflow, and platform issues.
* Lead, mentor, and guide Workday technical specialists while promoting knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with business, HR, Finance, PSA, and technology teams to ensure successful delivery of integration initiatives within scope, schedule, and quality expectations.
Manage integration roadmaps, RAID logs, status reporting, risk mitigation activities, and stakeholder communications across multiple projects and support engagements.  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* 8+ years of experience, including significant hands-on experience in Workday Integration development, support, and solution delivery.
* Deep expertise in Workday Integration technologies, including Workday Studio, EIB, Web Services APIs, Cloud Connectors, PECI, Report Writer, and Enterprise Interface design.
* Strong experience with Workday Business Process Framework, Configurable Security, Calculated Fields, and Workday reporting solutions.
* Hands-on experience developing and supporting Workday Extend applications, workflows, integrations, and custom business solutions.
* Strong integration experience using XML, XSLT, Web Services, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware solutions such as Informatica, and enterprise integration technologies.
* Experience supporting Workday HCM, Financials, and Professional Services Automation (PSA) integrations within complex enterprise environments.
* Proven experience leading integration projects, managing stakeholders, conducting workshops, troubleshooting critical production issues, and driving successful delivery outcomes.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business teams.  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

  

* Knowledge and experience with Workday Orchestrate for workflow automation and integration orchestration.
* Experience designing integrations across cloud, hybrid, and enterprise application ecosystems using modern integration architectures.
* Experience with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and modern engineering practices.
* Certification in Workday Integration, Workday Extend, or related Workday technical specializations preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, along with certifications in Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), is highly desirable.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Safety Data Consultant

We are looking for a **Safety Data Consultant** with deep expertise in safety data, pharmacovigilance systems, and data modernization initiatives.

As a Safety Data Transformation Consultant, you will help clients transform how Pharmacovigilance data is governed, integrated, standardized, and consumed across the safety landscape. * Define safety data transformation roadmaps aligned to business and regulatory objectives.
* Assess current-state safety data ecosystems and identify optimization opportunities.
* Drive modernization of safety data platforms, integrations, and reporting capabilities.
* Enable trusted, scalable, and reusable safety data assets.

**Data Governance & Standards**

* Establish and maintain safety data governance frameworks.
* Define safety data standards, business rules, metadata, and data quality controls.
* Collaborate with Data Owners, Data Stewards, and Technology teams to improve data integrity and traceability.
* Support implementation of sustainable data stewardship practices.

**Safety Data Products & Analytics**

* Partner with business stakeholders to define requirements for safety data products.
* Support development of data models, analytics platforms, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
* Enable consistent and compliant safety data consumption across the organization.
* Drive adoption of data-driven decision-making practices.

**Data Integration & Modernization**

* Support data migration, platform consolidation, and system integration initiatives.
* Collaborate with architects and engineering teams on solution design.
* Ensure alignment between business requirements, regulatory expectations, and technical implementation.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as a trusted advisor across Safety Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, IT, and Data & Analytics teams.
* Facilitate workshops and requirements discussions.

Provide guidance on safety data best practices and industry trends.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Computer Science, or related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Pharmacovigilance Data Management, Safety Analytics, Data Governance, or Safety Data Transformation.

* Experience with data governance, data quality, metadata, and data standards.
* Ability to translate business needs into scalable data solutions.
* Excellent communication and consulting skills.

* Experience with Oracle Argus Safety and safety data repositories.
* Knowledge of MedDRA, WHO Drug Dictionary, and Pharmacovigilance data standards.

* Exposure to AI/ML-enabled safety analytics and reporting solutions.

title: System Architect – Platform Engineering & Cloud
description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

### **Role Definition**

Own and evolve the end-to-end technical architecture for the platform ecosystem, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, integrated, resilient, cost-effective, and operationally reliable.

Define architecture across applications, cloud platforms, data, APIs, integrations, and shared platform capabilities, translating business and product needs into implementable designs and engineering standards. Create HLDs and architecture patterns, guide LLDs, and ensure architectural decisions are successfully translated into working solutions.

This is a **hands-on architecture and engineering role**. The System Architect will actively contribute to software development, including production code, reference implementations, technical prototypes, code reviews, and complex feature delivery.

The role remains technically accountable through production, **leading diagnosis of complex cross-system issues** and driving architectural and engineering improvements through resolution and stabilisation.

### **Responsibilities**

### **Architecture & Technical Design**

* Own end-to-end architecture across application, platform, data, and integration layers
* Create HLDs, reference architectures, reusable patterns, and key technical designs
* Guide LLDs and ensure implementations remain aligned with architectural intent
* Define standards for APIs, microservices, data flows, identity, integration, and cloud-native solutions
* Make technical trade-offs across scalability, reliability, security, performance, maintainability, and cloud cost

### **Hands-On Engineering & Development**

* Actively participate in software development and complex feature implementation
* Write, debug, test, and review production-quality code
* Build prototypes, reference implementations, reusable components, and technical accelerators
* Participate in code and design reviews and improve engineering quality and maintainability
* Validate architectural decisions through working software, testing, and production evidence

### **Platform & Cloud Engineering**

* Design distributed and cloud-native solutions across AWS and Azure
* Establish reusable capabilities for identity, integration, environments, containerisation, CI/CD, and microservices
* Guide application modernisation and cloud adoption
* Design for high availability, resilience, scalability, security, and cost efficiency
* Reduce project-specific solutions through reusable platform services and engineering patterns

### **Production Reliability & Technical Problem Solving**

* Define observability across logging, metrics, tracing, health checks, dashboards, and alerting
* **Lead diagnosis of complex cross-system production issues**, working directly with code, telemetry, configuration, integrations, and infrastructure to identify root cause
* Drive technical resolution through implementation and stabilisation
* Address recurring issues through architectural and engineering improvements
* Ensure systems are secure, observable, supportable, and production-ready

### **Technical Leadership & Governance**

* Establish architecture and engineering standards across teams
* Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on technical guidance
* Evaluate technologies and frameworks based on engineering value, risk, cost, and long-term sustainability
* Partner with Product, Security, Data, DevOps, Product Support, and Engineering teams while retaining architectural accountability

### **Skill Descriptors**

### **System & Cloud Architecture (Extensive Experience)**

* Designs complex distributed and cloud-native systems across AWS and Azure
* Defines application, **data and database architecture**, including data flows, storage patterns, schemas, performance, and scalability
* Applies **security-by-design**, including identity, access, service security, certificates, and secure architecture patterns
* Makes effective trade-offs across scalability, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and cost

### **Hands-On Software Engineering (Extensive Experience)**

* Strong hands-on software development capability, preferably Java
* Writes, tests, debugs, reviews, maintains, and troubleshoots production software
* Builds APIs, services, prototypes, reference implementations, and reusable components
* Translates architectural decisions into working production implementations
* Diagnoses difficult problems spanning application and platform boundaries

### **Platform, Integration & DevOps (Extensive Experience)**

* Designs APIs, microservices, event-driven integrations, and reusable platform capabilities
* Strong understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, environment management, and modern DevOps practices
* Designs resilient integrations with clear service contracts, dependencies, and failure handling
* Applies platform engineering principles to reduce duplication and accelerate product delivery
* Understands database, real-time data processing, messaging, and distributed-system patterns

### **Production Engineering & Technical Leadership (Extensive Experience)**

* Designs for observability, high availability, resilience, recovery, and operational support
* Leads root-cause diagnosis of complex production and performance issues
* Uses logs, metrics, traces, application behaviour, code, and infrastructure evidence to drive technical decisions
* Leads through technical depth, working implementations, engineering standards, and mentoring
* Drives systemic improvements following production failures rather than treating incidents as isolated events

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field
* **10+ years** of software engineering, architecture, or distributed-systems experience
* Strong hands-on Java development experience
* Production experience designing/ implementing cloud-native systems on AWS/ Azure
* Strong experience with distributed systems, APIs, microservices, data/integration patterns, and production troubleshooting
* Experience with containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, relational databases, and modern software engineering practices
* AWS and/or Azure Solution Architect certification preferred

### **Success Metrics**

* Improved platform reliability, scalability, performance, and security
* Reduction in architecture and integration-related production issues
* Faster diagnosis and recovery of complex system failures
* Adoption and reuse of common architecture and platform patterns
* Increased compliance with observability and production-readiness standards
* Improved cloud cost efficiency
* Successful translation of architecture into high-quality production implementations

**Posting Dates:**

November 4, 2026 - November 17, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.
