title: AI Ops Engineer
description:
The Ford Credit Global Data Insights and Analytics (FC - GDIA) department is looking for a motivated and talented AI – Ops Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI operations expertise to build, automate, and secure the platform that powers our advanced artificial intelligence solutions for the Ford Credit team.  
In this role, you will act as the backbone of our quantitative analytics and AI engineering teams. Your primary mission will be to design, automate, and operate the end-to-end cloud and AI infrastructure — including CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, observability, and platform guardrails — so that our Generative AI applications and modelers can run safely, scalably, and reliably in production.

* **Cloud Platform Engineering:** Architect and operate highly available, multi-service AI infrastructure on the cloud, managing the full lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, and security for AI workloads.
* **AI-Ops / LLMOps Pipelines:** Establish robust MLOps and LLMOps pipelines covering the end-to-end lifecycle of Generative AI tools — including model deployment, version control, prompt and artifact tracking, automated evaluation, and continuous monitoring for performance, drift, and hallucination mitigation.
* **CI/CD Automation:** Design and maintain automated build, test, and deployment pipelines for full-stack AI applications, ensuring seamless and secure continuous integration and delivery across front-end, back-end, and AI components.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Build, Kubernetes manifests) to deliver reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments.
* **Containerization & Orchestration:** Build and operate containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes), managing scaling, rolling deployments, resource optimization, and service resilience for AI workloads.
* **Observability & Reliability:** Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and SRE practices to ensure platform reliability, availability, and performance of AI applications in production.
* **Security & Governance:** Embed security across the platform — identity and access management, secrets management, network policies, and data protection — ensuring all AI workloads meet Ford's strict data privacy, security, and compliance standards.
* **Developer Enablement:** Work closely with AI engineers, software engineers, and analytical modelers to provide self-service tooling, environments, and automated workflows that remove friction from development to production.  
    
  **Skills Knowledge Required**
  + **Cloud Platform:** Extensive hands-on experience with a leading cloud provider (e.g., Google Cloud Platform), including Cloud Run, Cloud Build, GKE, GCS, BigQuery, IAM, VPC networking, and Secret Manager.
  + **DevOps / SRE Practices:** Strong proficiency in CI/CD tooling, GitOps, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud-native monitoring and logging.
  + **AI-Ops / LLMOps:** Proficiency in tools and platforms for model deployment, prompt/model versioning, evaluation, tracing, and monitoring of LLM and GenAI outputs.
  + **Scripting & Automation:** Hands-on experience with a programming/scripting language such as Python, or Bash for automating infrastructure and operational tasks, and for building tooling that serves collaborators.
  + **Software Engineering Fundamentals:** Working knowledge of full-stack application architecture and modern deployment patterns for AI tools, with the ability to integrate front-end, back-end, and AI services reliably.
  + **Security & Compliance:** Familiarity with cloud security best practices, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance standards in regulated environments.
  + **Analytics Workflow Understanding:** Awareness of the typical workflows of data scientists and modelers (data wrangling, feature engineering, model validation) so you can build reliable platforms and pipelines that serve them.
* **Qualifications Experience**
  + **Education:** Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  + **DevOps/Cloud Engineering Experience:** 3–5 years of overall experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or SRE, with at least 1–2 years of dedicated, hands-on experience deploying and operating AI, ML, and Generative AI applications in production.
  + **AI/MLOps Engineering:** Proven track record of implementing CI/CD for AI workloads, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure management (Terraform, Cloud Build, GKE).
  + **Automation & Reliability:** Demonstrated experience with infrastructure automation, incident response, and building observable, self-healing production systems.
  + **Good to Have (Optional)::** Previous exposure to the Banking, Financial Services, or Credit Analytics industries. Experience with Machine Learning engineering and model serving frameworks, or relevant cloud certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer / Cloud Architect).

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable.

The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix — Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions — ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks.

The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations.  
  
**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation**

* Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments.
* Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology.

**Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build**

* Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained.
* Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership.

**Integration and Data Engineering**

* Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

**DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management**

* Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management.
* Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control.
* Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles.

**Vendor and Managed Service Delivery**

* Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance.
* Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Alignment**

* Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability.
* Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums.

**Organisational Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8–10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources.
* Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality.

**Compliance, Risk and Governance**

* Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements.
* Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management.

**QUALIFICATIONS**  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application.
* Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies.
* Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline.
* Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management.
* Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred.
* Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness
* Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context.
* Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon).
* Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions.
* Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes.
* Recognised cloud or architecture certification.

**PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS**

Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work.  
  
**NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel up to 20%

Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare.  
  
**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**  
Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead.

Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation.

External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners.  
  
**RESOURCES MANAGED**  
**Financial Accountability**

Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation  
**Supervision**

Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects,integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleague's leadership.

  
Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

title: SFDC Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced **Salesforce Solution Architect** with 10+ years of experience to lead the design, development, and evolution of enterprise Salesforce solutions supporting global B2B and B2C business operations.The ideal candidate will combine strong solution architecture capabilities with hands-on Salesforce technical expertise. The role requires someone who can translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions, guide development teams, make sound architectural decisions, and write or debug code when required.The architect will work across multiple Salesforce applications, external enterprise systems, country-specific business processes, and cross-functional technology teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and long-term business objectives.**Key Responsibilities1. Solution Architecture and Design**

* Own end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture, from requirements discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and production support.
* Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce architectures, technical designs, data models, integration patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
* Evaluate standard Salesforce capabilities, configuration, declarative automation, custom development, and external services to recommend the most appropriate solution.
* Define architectural standards, reusable components, coding guidelines, design patterns, and technical best practices.
* Assess the impact of proposed changes on existing applications, integrations, business processes, and future enhancements.
* Identify technical risks, scalability constraints, platform limitations, and opportunities for simplification.

**2. Hands-on Salesforce Development**

* Write, review, debug, and optimize Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and other Salesforce customizations when required.
* Develop proof-of-concepts and technical prototypes to validate architectural decisions and resolve complex technical challenges.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of Apex triggers, asynchronous processing, Batch Apex, Queueable Apex, platform events, transaction management, and governor limits.
* Ensure code follows bulkification, security, exception-handling, testability, and performance best practices.
* Review complex implementations and guide developers in resolving technical issues.
* Participate directly in critical development activities, production troubleshooting, and performance optimization when necessary.

**3. Salesforce Data Modeling and Governance**

* Design scalable Salesforce data models using standard and custom objects, appropriate relationships, and well-defined ownership and sharing strategies.
* Define data mastership, external identifiers, deduplication, matching, data migration, and reconciliation approaches.
* Design data models that support global customer identities, B2B relationships, B2C customer journeys, and country-specific business requirements.
* Ensure appropriate data access, privacy, auditability, and regulatory considerations are incorporated into the architecture.

**4. Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern integrations between Salesforce and enterprise platforms such as SAP, customer portals, identity providers, middleware, and marketing platforms.
* Define suitable integration patterns using REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, and middleware where appropriate.
* Address authentication, authorization, idempotency, retries, error handling, monitoring, reconciliation, and integration resilience.
* Collaborate with enterprise integration and platform teams to manage dependencies, API contracts, release sequencing, and system-wide changes.

**5. Global Platform and Release Governance**

* Support a global Salesforce platform operating across multiple countries and business markets.
* Balance global architecture standards with legitimate local business and regulatory requirements.
* Evaluate the impact of changes across countries, applications, integrations, and downstream systems before approving designs.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, development teams, QA, DevOps, security, and platform teams to ensure controlled delivery.
* Contribute to release planning, technical risk assessments, environment strategy, deployment readiness, and production stability.
* Prevent unnecessary customization and architectural fragmentation across markets.

**6. Technical Leadership and Team Enablement**

* Provide technical direction and architectural guidance to Salesforce developers, technical leads, QA engineers, and integration teams.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, design walkthroughs, and technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Establish development standards and reusable patterns that improve code quality, maintainability, and developer productivity.
* Mentor team members and support technical decision-making across distributed teams.
* Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

**7. Platform Evolution and Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, technical fit, and platform strategy.
* Identify opportunities to improve performance, reduce technical debt, simplify integrations, and optimize delivery costs.
* Contribute to Salesforce platform roadmaps and long-term architecture decisions.
* Support production incident analysis and implement sustainable solutions that prevent recurring issues.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* Hands-on experience with Apex, Triggers, LWC, SOQL, Salesforce security, and declarative automation.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling, sharing and visibility, governor limits, transaction boundaries, and platform architecture.
* Experience designing enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and asynchronous or event-driven patterns.
* Understanding of integration resilience, error handling, monitoring, data reconciliation, and API security.
* Experience with Salesforce deployments, source control, CI/CD, and release management.
* Familiarity with enterprise identity and access management, SSO, OAuth, and external identity solutions.
* Ability to diagnose complex technical issues and validate architectural decisions through working code or prototypes.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and customer engagement integrations.
* Exposure to Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud.
* Experience with SAP or other ERP integrations.
* Experience with middleware and integration platforms such as MuleSoft, SnapLogic, Informatica, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with multi-country Salesforce implementations and global platform governance.
* Experience with Experience Cloud portals, external users, customer identity, and large-scale customer data management.
* Familiarity with consent management, customer data privacy, and market-specific regulatory requirements.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Typically 10+ years of Salesforce or relevant enterprise CRM experience.
* Demonstrated experience owning solution architecture for complex Salesforce implementations.
* Proven experience leading technical teams and collaborating across business and technology functions.
* Salesforce Application Architect certification preferred; System Architect or relevant advanced certifications are an advantage.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.

**Success Criteria**The successful candidate will be expected to:

* Deliver scalable and maintainable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
* Make defensible design decisions with clear consideration of alternatives, risks, and trade-offs.
* Independently validate critical technical designs through code, prototypes, debugging, and code reviews.
* Minimize regression risk across existing systems, integrations, and country implementations.
* Improve engineering standards and enable development teams to deliver consistently.
* Maintain a balance between architectural leadership and hands-on technical contribution.

**Role Expectation**This is an architecture-led role with hands-on technical responsibilities. The candidate is not expected to spend every day implementing features, but must be capable of independently writing and debugging Apex and related Salesforce code when complex technical challenges, critical issues, or architectural validation require it.

Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹4,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Account Manager, TSG, IT & ITES, AWS India
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you have the business savvy and technical background to help establish Amazon Web Services as the preferred cloud platform for India's IT and ITeS industry? AWS India is seeking a Senior Account Manager to lead cloud strategy and revenue growth across one of India's most dynamic and globally influential sectors.  
  
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  
  
As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own the end-to-end cloud strategy for a portfolio of strategic, high-revenue IT services companies, software product firms, and technology-enabled services organizations. You will operate as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, influencing multi-year technology decisions and driving large-scale digital transformation programs. This role requires you to think at the level of how India's leading technology companies architect their platforms, modernize their delivery models, and build next-generation solutions on AWS for their global customers. You will define the strategic direction for your accounts, execute complex multi-stakeholder commercial engagements, mentor junior Account Managers, contribute to segment-level strategy, and represent the voice of the IT/ITeS customer within AWS to influence product roadmaps and go-to-market priorities.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Drive Cloud Adoption Across IT/ITeS Organizations: Lead strategic sales initiatives focused on workload migration, application modernization, DevOps transformation, and AI/ML adoption to help IT/ITeS companies build competitive advantage through AWS.
* Own the long-term cloud strategy for your accounts and develop multi-year account plans that align AWS capabilities with customer business objectives, including platform modernization, IP development on AWS, and enabling customers to build cloud-native offerings for their end clients.
* Executive Relationship Building and Influence: Establish and sustain CXO-level relationships across your accounts. Engage with CEOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers, Engineering Heads, and Delivery Leaders to position AWS as a strategic partner.
* Influence technology decisions at the board level and drive executive alignment on large transformation programs.
* Complex Deal Structuring and Negotiation: Lead multi-year commercial engagements including EDPs, PPAs, and custom pricing constructs.
* Navigate complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders, legal teams, and partner ecosystems.
* Structure deals that balance customer value with AWS business objectives.
* Cross-Functional Orchestration: Operate as the single-threaded leader for your accounts, orchestrating across Solutions Architects, Partner teams, Professional Services, Specialist sellers, and Product teams to deliver cohesive customer outcomes.
* Segment Strategy and Market Shaping: Contribute to the IT/ITeS segment strategy by identifying industry trends, competitive dynamics, and whitespace opportunities. Provide inputs that shape go-to-market priorities, pricing strategies, and product investments for the segment.
* Revenue Growth and Pipeline Management: Own revenue targets, build and manage a healthy sales pipeline, forecast accurately, and drive deals through complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
* Customer Success and Expansion: Ensure successful onboarding and adoption of AWS services, identify expansion opportunities across different business units and service lines, and drive consumption growth through strategic engagement across GenAI, data analytics, and modernization use cases.
* Thought Leadership and Advocacy: Organize and participate in workshops, hackathons, webinars, and industry events to build AWS mindshare, showcase customer success stories, and establish AWS as the innovation partner of choice for IT/ITeS organizations.

  
A day in the life  
As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be responsible for driving their cloud journey from initial engagement through large-scale adoption. Your day will involve a mix of strategic planning, customer engagement, internal collaboration, deal execution, and team development activities.  
  
A typical day may include:  
  
Strategic Planning: Reviewing multi-year account plans, analyzing consumption trends, identifying whitespace opportunities, and preparing for upcoming customer engagements with clear objectives and value propositions. Assessing deal progression across your portfolio, identifying blockers, and aligning resources to accelerate critical opportunities.  
  
Customer Meetings: Conducting CXO steering committees and executive briefings with business leaders, technical deep-dives with engineering teams, and business reviews with account stakeholders to drive alignment and momentum on large transformation programs.  
  
Internal Collaboration: Working with Solutions Architects on technical proposals, coordinating with Partner teams on joint go-to-market initiatives, engaging Product teams to address customer requirements, and providing customer feedback that influences service roadmaps critical to the IT/ITeS segment.  
  
Deal Progression: Advancing complex commercial engagements through the sales cycle, structuring multi-year agreements, addressing procurement and commercial discussions, negotiating contracts, and removing blockers to close deals.  
Relationship Development: Building trusted advisor relationships through regular cadence calls, proactive outreach, sharing relevant insights and best practices, and connecting customers with AWS resources and expertise.  
  
Knowledge Building: Staying current on AWS service launches, industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer success stories to bring fresh ideas and relevant insights to customer conversations.  
  
About the team  
About the team  
The IT/ITeS segment team focuses on one of India's most strategic industries, organizations that are transforming their own operations through cloud and building cloud-native solutions and services for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a collaborative, high-energy team that values customer obsession, innovation, and results.  
  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
* MBA, or Bachelor's degree or above
* 10+ years of technology sales selling enterprise software, networking, infrastructure, managed hosting services, or cloud computing services experience.
* Experience consistently exceeding revenue targets in complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments.
* Experience owning and managing strategic accounts with multi-year commercial engagements.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* MBA, or Advanced degree
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience in technology sales selling enterprise software, networking, infrastructure, managed hosting services, or cloud computing services

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Pyspark Engineer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven **PySpark / Big Data Engineer** to design, develop, and maintain large-scale batch and real-time data pipelines. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming complex raw data into actionable analytical data models, optimizing distributed computing workloads, and ensuring data integrity, scalability, and security across enterprise data platforms.

The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Apache Spark architecture, advanced Python programming, distributed systems optimization, modern cloud platforms, and data warehousing/lakehouse paradigms.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Data Pipeline Design & Development**
--------------------------------------

* Architect, build, and maintain robust, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using **PySpark** and **Python** to ingest data from diverse batch and streaming sources (Kafka, relational databases, REST APIs, Object Storage).
* Design and implement Lakehouse architectures using formats such as **Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi**.
* Build reusable frameworks and data ingestion libraries to standardize enterprise data processing.

**Spark Performance Tuning & Optimization**
-------------------------------------------

* Diagnose and tune Spark application performance, managing memory allocation, partitions, execution plans, broadcast joins, data skews, and garbage collection.
* Optimize query execution plans using Catalyst Optimizer and Tungsten execution engine.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production Spark jobs across cluster management environments (YARN, Kubernetes, or Databricks).

**Data Modeling & Architecture**
--------------------------------

* Collaborate with Data Architects to design dimensional (Star/Snowflake), normalized, and Data Vault schemas optimized for analytical workloads.
* Ensure efficient data storage, partitioning strategies, and file format selection (Parquet, ORC, Avro).

**Orchestration, CI/CD & DevOps**
---------------------------------

* Schedule and orchestrate complex workflow DAGs using workflow orchestrators such as **Apache Airflow**, Prefect, or Dagster.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) for automated testing, packaging, and deployment of data pipelines.
* Write unit tests, integration tests, and data validation routines (e.g., Great Expectations, PyTest).

**Governance, Security & Quality**
----------------------------------

* Implement enterprise data governance, lineage tracking, metadata management, and data quality frameworks.
* Ensure strict compliance with data security, masking, tokenization, RBAC, and regulatory privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

**Required Technical Qualifications & Skills**
----------------------------------------------

* **Core Technologies -** Apache Spark, PySpark (Spark SQL, DataFrames, Datasets, Structured Streaming), Python 3.x
* **Database & Querying -** Advanced SQL, Query optimization, Indexing, Window functions
* **Data Lake & Lakehouse -** Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Parquet, Avro, ORC
* **Workflow & Orchestration -** Apache Airflow, Luigi, Prefect, or Databricks Workflows
* **Cloud Platforms -** AWS (EMR, Glue, S3, Redshift), Azure (Synapse, ADLS, HDInsight), or GCP (Dataproc, BigQuery, GCS)
* **Streaming Technologies -** Apache Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Event Hubs, or Kinesis

**Key Competencies & Experience**
---------------------------------

* **Distributed Computing Fundamentals:** In-depth knowledge of Spark internals (RDD, Catalyst Optimizer, DAG execution, Shuffling, Narrow vs. Wide dependencies).
* **Production Experience:** Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade PySpark applications at enterprise scale.

title: Supv-Solutions Archt
description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**

**Type of Work:** Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.

**Expected Volumes:** Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.

**Risk & Criticality:** You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.

### **What we’re looking for...**

* **Team Leadership & Mentorship:** Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* **Executive Deal Sponsorship:** Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* **Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization:** Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* **Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM:** Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* **Deal & Technical Escalation:** Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* **Architectural & Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) *prior* to contract signature.
* **Strategic Product Advocacy:** Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* **AI/Automation Acumen:** Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecom/IT/Communications or a relevant engineering field.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading technical pre-sales teams.
* **Comprehensive Core Networking:** Deep architectural understanding of traditional and modern WAN solutions, including global MPLS, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), high-availability Broadband aggregation, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SD-WAN).
* **Advanced Wireless & 5G:** Strong knowledge of cellular networks, LTE, Private 5G, and IoT ecosystems.
* **Voice/UC Expertise:** Strong understanding of overarching VoIP architectures, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), SIP trunking, and contact center modernization paths.
* **Cloud Computing Expertise:** Proven experience overseeing the design and integration of telecom solutions within public, private, or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Proven ability to orchestrate complex technical workflows across a matrixed organization, driving executive alignment between sales, technical, and delivery teams.
* Ability to quickly learn, understand, and guide your team on emerging technologies and methodologies in the telecommunications and cloud space.
* Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as CCNP (Automation/Data Center/Wireless), ITIL Foundation, or equivalent.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

40

title: Frontier Transformation Lead
description:
**Leading at Cognizant**

This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level: **Drive our business strategy** and inspire teams around our future. **Live the leadership behaviors**, leading themselves, others and the business. **Uphold our Values**, role modeling themin every action and decision. **Nurture our people and culture**, creating a workplace where all can thrive.

At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.

**About the role**

As a Frontier Transformation Lead, you will make an impact by building the reusable intellectual capital of the Frontier Capability Unit (FCU) - the offerings, methodologies, accelerators, tools and assets that give SEG's AI-native engagement model its edge - and taking that capital to market and into client delivery. You will be a valued member of the Frontier Capability Unit team and work collaboratively with SEG Solutioning, GSA, the IDU and Frontier Talent community, hyperscaler and model partners, industry analysts, and clients.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own the offering and accelerator roadmap across Agentic Coding & ADLC, Autonomous Agents & Runtime and Vertical Solutions, including domain and hyperscaler-specific offerings, and sponsor the Garage / R&D build of new assets and proof points ahead of client demand.
* Build and maintain delivery kits, composable tooling (MCP & Skills), delivery methodology and pod-design patterns consumed by the IDU and the Frontier Talent community, owning their availability and quality.
* Own the asset / IP register for the unit and the Enterprise Runtime & Governance standard that assets must meet before they are published for re-use.
* Supply estimation models, productivity guidance and Assurance & Evaluation proof points into new and vendor-consolidation deals, and co-create bid support with SEG Solutioning / GSA.
* Own hyperscaler, model-partner (Anthropic, Google / Gemini, OpenAI) and Agentic Trust & Security ecosystem relationships and represent the FCU's capability to industry analysts.
* Consistently demonstrate the **Cognizant Way to Lead,** which means operating with **Personal Leadership** (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), **Organizational Leadership** (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and **Business Leadership** (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen)

**What you need to have to be considered**

* 20+ years in IT services, with 10+ years in AI-native / GenAI engineering, solutioning or offering & IP leadership.
* Strong technical / solutioning grounding in AI-native and GenAI engineering, credible enough to set an offering roadmap and engage architects and partners.
* A proven track record of taking IP to market through pre-sales support, accelerator build, and analyst / partner engagement.
* Experience building estimation and proof-point models for bids and connecting offerings to commercial outcomes such as TCV and pricing-to-win.
* A builder-evangelist profile with market-facing scope, able to lead a direct and indirect span of 20-30 across pillar-aligned focus areas.
* Embodiment of the **Cognizant Way to Lead**: Leading Self, Leading Others, & Leading the Business
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The right Thing, & Own It

**These will help you succeed**

* Working knowledge of major model and cloud ecosystems — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google / Gemini, Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and determine enterprise readiness.
* Experience designing reference architectures, engineering standards and delivery patterns.
* Strong market-sensing skills that convert frontier technology trends into a forward offering roadmap.
* Experience industrialising reusable offerings, accelerators and methodologies that differentiate at scale.

**Work model**

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

Honesty, Reliability, Curiosity, Collaboration, and Passion.

* Conduct discovery and assessment workshops (often in collaboration with resources from consulting, operations and product teams) to help drive further penetration of the client account
* Develop and document solutions that meet client’s (technical and business) requirements and allow them to adapt to changing industry needs with a focus on transformation and re-platform efforts
* Conduct solution development sessions and present technical solutions and business cases to a wide variety of audience
* Gain executives buy in for complex solutions by engaging in executive and senior-level technology discussions
* Gain clients’ confidence as a trusted advisor by offering consultation and recommendations drawing from technology know-how and past experiences
* Align and partner with Product Management to help drive appropriate product enhancements and changes to technology roadmap
* Aid in driving stability and innovation within the client’s current and future state and create solutions based on client requirements and available product offerings

  

**We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That’s why we’ve outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it’s important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.**

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer sciences
* 20+ years of experience as an architect or equivalent in the hosting and network space (preferably with a service provider)
* Over 12 years’ experience as a Modernization or Migration Architect, leading legacy system upgrades to new platforms with minimal business disruption.
* Hands-on experience with Mainframe Application migration and legacy modernization projects.
* 15+ years of experience with strong expertise across the mainframe technology stack, including COBOL, Natural, Adabas, Easytrieve, Db2, IMS, JCL, CICS, VSAM, RACF, z/OS, PL/I, and Assembler.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven experience in managing projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing multi-phase/multi-dimensional/multi-resource projects to conclusion while maintaining high client satisfaction
* Demonstrated expertise in data migration, with a strong emphasis on understanding and working with legacy data structures to effectively convert and modernize them into modern database platforms.
* Skilled in evaluating mainframe legacy applications and developing comprehensive modernization plans.
* Demonstrated development experience with modern Java and C# frameworks, including designing and implementing scalable enterprise applications.
* Additionally, has extensive experience working with Python, applying the language for scripting, automation, data analysis, and developing scalable backend systems that facilitate enterprise modernization efforts.
* Understanding of (and experience with) public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and hybrid solutions preferred
* Demonstrated ability to understand and leverage Artificial Intelligence, applying AI-driven strategies and tools to modernize legacy systems and enhance data migration efforts.
* Skilled in identifying use cases for AI within legacy modernization practices, driving innovation by integrating intelligent automation, advanced analytics, and machine learning solutions to streamline processes and create future-ready technologically
* Well versed in the hosting technology landscape including compute, storage, backup, network, security, DR, DevOps and IT governance
* Good understanding of the sales process for large and complex opportunities.

* Has experience in technical documentation to capture solution components in a timely manner while ensuring acceptable level of detail, data integrity, and accountability
* Ability to share knowledge and expertise among various organizations within the company and to facilitate teamwork among those organizations to better serve our clients
* Ability to work in a team environment and demonstrate strong problem-solving skills
* Proficient with common office applications such as MS Outlook, MS Excel, PowerPoint and MS Visio

We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. We are looking for a **Principal AIOps Architect** to spearhead large-scale AIOps, Intelligent Operations, and Agentic AI transformation efforts, shaping architectural direction across cloud, automation, and AI-powered operational intelligence platforms for major enterprise initiatives.

**Responsibilities**

* Direct large-scale AIOps, Intelligent Operations, Agentic AI, and automation transformation programs by establishing target-state architecture, modernization roadmaps, governance frameworks, and reusable solution patterns
* Design observability and operational intelligence solutions spanning metrics, logs, traces, events, topology, service dependencies, incidents, deployments, and configuration changes to support anomaly detection, event correlation, service-impact analysis, and AI-assisted root cause analysis
* Build Agentic AI solutions for IT Operations leveraging Amazon Bedrock/AgentCore, Microsoft Foundry/Azure OpenAI, or Gemini/Vertex AI Agent Engine to support reasoning, knowledge retrieval, tool invocation, multi-step investigation, recommendations, and operational decision-making
* Develop autonomous and semi-autonomous remediation solutions incorporating policy controls, identity and access verification, risk assessment, Human-in-the-Loop approvals, rollback, recovery validation, auditability, and feedback loops
* Connect AIOps platforms with ITSM/CMDB, observability, CI/CD, cloud-management, knowledge, security, automation platforms, and enterprise APIs, including ServiceNow or similar tools
* Oversee enterprise architecture reviews, solution assurance, design authority decisions, non-functional requirements, security, resilience, scalability, operational governance, and technical leadership across Cloud, SRE, DevOps, Platform, Operations, and AI teams
* Head RFP/RFI/RFQ efforts and pre-sales solutioning, covering technical discovery, solution architecture, transformation strategy, estimations, staffing models, implementation roadmaps, assumptions, risks, dependencies, TCO analysis, and technical proposal creation
* Interact with senior customer and executive stakeholders, run architecture workshops and solution defenses, and partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, Delivery, Engineering, Practice, and Commercial teams to craft technically sound and competitive solutions

**Requirements**

* 18-25 years of overall IT experience, with substantial background in Enterprise/Solution Architecture, Cloud, SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, IT Operations, Automation, or AIOps
* Deep experience building large-scale AIOps and intelligent operations platforms, covering observability, anomaly detection, event correlation, noise reduction, service-impact analysis, AI-assisted RCA, remediation, and operational automation
* Strong command of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud), including enterprise cloud architecture, security, identity, networking, governance, resilience, and scalability
* Direct architecture experience with at least one Agentic AI ecosystem, such as Amazon Bedrock/AgentCore, Microsoft Foundry/Azure OpenAI, or Gemini/Vertex AI Agent Engine/Google ADK
* Solid grasp of Agentic AI architectures, including reasoning, planning, tool/function calling, RAG/knowledge grounding, context and memory, multi-agent orchestration, agent evaluation, Human-in-the-Loop processes, guardrails, and policy enforcement
* Background in designing autonomous/self-healing operations, event-driven remediation, workflow orchestration, ITSM integration, operational governance, and secure interactions between AI agents and enterprise systems
* Strong Python skills for building Agentic AI solutions, APIs, integrations, automation, telemetry processing, orchestration, and rapid prototyping
* Track record in RFP/RFI solutioning, pre-sales architecture, technical proposal development, estimations, solution defense, executive stakeholder engagement, and technical leadership across large enterprise transformation programs

* Exposure to multiple major cloud platforms along with familiarity with enterprise observability tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or Elastic
* Working knowledge of LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Strands Agents, Google ADK, MCP, A2A, RAG, vector databases, or knowledge graphs
* Experience with SRE, FinOps, cloud economics, capacity optimization, predictive operations, and managed-services solutioning
* Relevant certifications in Cloud Architecture, AI, Enterprise Architecture, SRE, ITIL, or TOGAF

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies

* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons

title: Sr.Salesforce Developer_PTSN
description:

This role defines domain-specific guidelines, oversees integration with enterprise systems, and designs scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. Acting as a subject matter expert, this role drives innovation and ensures domain architectures enable growth and efficiency.

Domain Ownership: Own architecture decisions for assigned domain; approve solution designs within domain; maintain domain roadmap.

Standards & Best Practices: Define and publish domain-specific guidelines; enforce adherence; review and approve exceptions.

Integration Oversight: Ensure domain solutions integrate with enterprise systems; validate interoperability; resolve integration conflicts.

Scalability & Performance: Design architectures that meet growth projections; monitor performance metrics; implement optimization strategies.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage business leaders to align domain solutions with strategic objectives; document trade-offs and decisions.

Risk Management: Identify domain-level risks; propose mitigation plans; track risk remediation progress.

Standards Adoption: Apply enterprise architecture standards, reference architectures, and reusable patterns in solution work; flag gaps or misalignment to senior architects. Assist in the creation and maintenance of architectural standards.

EA Collaboration: Participate in cross‑domain working sessions with enterprise architects to understand current-state and target-state architectures.

Contribute to Roadmap Execution: Support the realization of enterprise roadmaps by ensuring designs and components follow approved direction.

Technology Lifecycle & Portfolio Rationalization: Identify modernization opportunities including managing technical debt and assist with transformations or retirements.

Comply with Company and department policies and standards; performs other duties as assigned

Own end-to-end Salesforce architecture and technical governance for Sales Cloud, Revenue Cloud Advanced, Data 360, and Mobile.

Lead discussions and integration initiatives in a highly integrated environment with applications such as: SAP, Informatica, Workday, and Microsoft Fabric.

Define the target-state architecture: data model, security model, automation strategy (Flow vs Apex), and extensibility patterns.

Establish platform standards: org strategy, environments, DevOps approach, branching/release model, test strategy, and documentation.

Ensure Revenue Cloud Advanced design is scalable (products/pricing strategy, approvals, guided selling, complex quoting performance considerations).

Partner with the Product Owner and stakeholders to translate business outcomes into architecture decisions and technical requirements.

Mentor Administrators and Developers; conduct design reviews; serve as the escalation point for complex technical issues.

  
  
  

Qualifications

5 years salesforce Application Architect and/or System Architect (or equivalent experience).

Experience guiding development teams on solution design, technical standards, best practices, and platform governance.

40

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. title: Senior Data Architect
description:
The Data Technical Architect is the design authority for the data architecture that underpins the Command Centre and enables the Control Tower. The role owns how operational data from source systems across product domains is ingested, integrated, resolved, modelled, certified, and served as a single, trusted, near real‑time view of the business.
  

This is a data‑architecture‑led role. The primary deliverable is the target‑state data architecture – layering, canonical models, event and entity design, the semantic and KPI layer, and the data quality and lineage framework – that allows the Control Tower to detect exceptions, trigger alerts, and support root‑cause analysis with confidence in the underlying data.
  

The role works closely with Command Centre operations, BI delivery, Data Engineering, GDA, Data Platform, source system owners, and Enterprise Architecture, and operates within the standards set by the Tech Governance Lead.

This is a data‑architecture‑led role. The primary deliverable is the target‑state data architecture – layering, canonical models, event and entity design, the semantic and KPI layer, and the data quality and lineage framework – that allows the Control Tower to detect exceptions, trigger alerts, and support root‑cause analysis with confidence in the underlying data.


The role works closely with Command Centre operations, BI delivery, Data Engineering, GDA, Data Platform, source system owners, and Enterprise Architecture, and operates within the standards set by the Tech Governance Lead.
 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Data Architecture \& Design


Own the end‑to‑end data architecture for the Command Centre – how data flows from operational source systems across product domains (e.g. Contracts, Ocean) through to the Control Tower consumption layer.


Define the target‑state data architecture and transition roadmap, including the layering model (landing, raw, integrated/curated, consumption) and the storage, compute, and serving choices at each layer.


Design the canonical, cross‑domain data layer that gives the Control Tower one consistent representation of the core business objects, independent of the source systems they originate from.


Define master and reference data requirements, entity resolution, and cross‑system key mapping so that events from different systems resolve to the same business entity.


Establish data domain boundaries, data ownership, and data product definitions aligned to the Command Centre operating model.


Produce and maintain core architecture artefacts – conceptual, logical, and physical data models, data flow and lineage diagrams, integration maps, and architecture decision records.


Data Integration \& Pipeline Architecture


Architect real‑time, near real‑time, and batch ingestion patterns – streaming, event‑driven, CDC, API, and scheduled – and define which pattern applies to which source and use case.


Define the operational event model and payload standards for the milestones, status changes, and exceptions that drive Control Tower views.


Design pipeline patterns for reliability at scale: idempotency, replay, late‑arriving and out‑of‑order events, backfill, and reconciliation back to source.


Set standards for orchestration, dependency management, error and dead‑letter handling, and pipeline observability.


Define and agree data contracts and SLAs with source system teams, covering schema, frequency, volume, and change management.


Define latency, freshness, and throughput targets per data domain and ensure the architecture demonstrably meets them.


Data Modelling \& Semantic / KPI Layer


Design the dimensional, event, and state models required for end‑to‑end milestone tracking, cycle time, dwell, and exception analysis.


Architect the semantic and KPI layer so that each metric is defined once, certified, and reused consistently across Control Tower views and downstream reporting.


Model for drill‑down, so an alert on the Control Tower can be traced to transaction‑level detail and root cause without leaving the platform.


Define the historisation approach – slowly changing dimensions, snapshots, and point‑in‑time reporting – to support trend and retrospective analysis.


Design aggregation, pre‑computation, and caching strategies so Control Tower dashboards meet response‑time expectations at production data volumes.


Data Quality, Governance \& Security


Define data quality dimensions, rules, and thresholds at each architectural layer, and design how failures are detected, quarantined, and escalated.


Ensure Control Tower alerting is built on trusted data – design the freshness, completeness, and validity checks that gate what is surfaced to operations.


Design end‑to‑end metadata and lineage capture, from source system field through to published KPI.


Design role‑based access, row and column level security, masking, retention, and audit into the data architecture rather than bolting it on later.


Ensure alignment with enterprise data architecture, cloud strategy, and BI governance standards, and work with the Tech Governance Lead on dataset certification.


Identify, document, and drive remediation of data architecture technical debt.


Delivery \& Execution


Translate the architecture into sprint‑ready designs, data contracts, and backlog items for data engineering and BI delivery teams.


Provide hands‑on technical direction – prototypes, proofs of concept, performance tuning, and resolution of complex modelling and pipeline problems.


Review data models, pipelines, and semantic layers for adherence to the agreed architecture.


Own volumetrics and capacity planning, and support performance, resilience, and reconciliation testing ahead of each Control Tower release.


Drive reuse of data products, models, and patterns across Command Centre use cases to reduce duplication and rework.


Stakeholder \& Cross\-functional Collaboration


Partner with Command Centre operations and business owners to translate operational visibility and exception‑management needs into concrete data requirements.


Collaborate closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams, GDA, source system owners, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure and Cloud teams.


Present data architecture proposals to design authorities and governance forums for review and approval.


Communicate data design trade‑offs, risks, and dependencies clearly to non‑technical stakeholders.


Mentor data engineers and modellers on architecture patterns, modelling standards, and design quality.
 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS


Education \& Experience


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field.


Extensive experience as a data architect designing large‑scale, multi‑source data platforms, with hands‑on delivery experience rather than documentation only.


Proven experience designing the data architecture behind a control tower, command centre, or comparable real‑time operational visibility solution.


Track record of integrating operational and transactional source systems across multiple business domains.


Certifications in cloud data platforms, data architecture, or frameworks such as DAMA‑DMBOK or TOGAF are a plus.


Technical Competencies


* Deep data modelling expertise – conceptual, logical, and physical modelling; dimensional (Kimball), Data Vault, and event/state modelling.
* Strong experience with cloud data platforms, lakehouse and warehouse architectures, and layered (medallion‑style) design.
* Hands‑on experience with streaming and event‑driven architectures, CDC, message/event platforms, and API‑based integration.
* Advanced SQL and data performance engineering – partitioning, clustering, incremental processing, query tuning, and cost optimisation.
* Experience with orchestration and transformation frameworks and with data quality and observability tooling.
* Working knowledge of master data management, reference data, and entity resolution techniques.
* Experience with metadata, lineage, and data catalogue tooling, and with certified dataset practices.
* Strong understanding of data security, privacy, compliance, and governance, and the ability to design to them.
* Sufficient BI and visualisation knowledge to design a semantic layer that Control Tower dashboards can consume efficiently.

Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies


Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, particularly with source system owners.


Ability to communicate complex data concepts clearly and effectively.


High attention to detail combined with strategic, big‑picture thinking.


Sound judgement under operational pressure and in incident‑driven environments.


Proven ability to work across teams and drive alignment without direct authority.

* Lead the design, engineering, deployment, and continuous improvement of enterprise security tools and platforms, including EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, MDM, and Microsoft 365 security solutions.

* Manage and optimize integrations across security platforms, including EDR, SIEM, SOAR, MDM, IAM, and related monitoring tools.
* Drive incident detection and response engineering through alert tuning, detection use case development, correlation logic, and automation playbooks.
* Oversee deployment and enforcement of endpoint security controls, including DLP, USB/device control, device compliance policies, and endpoint hardening standards.
* Collaborate with SOC, Infrastructure, IAM, Cloud, and application teams to ensure security controls are implemented, monitored, and operationalized effectively.
* Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for security events, tool failures, policy issues, log ingestion gaps, and control effectiveness concerns.

* Participate in change management processes to assess security impact, define control requirements, and ensure security tooling remains aligned with approved changes.
* Drive automation initiatives using PowerShell, Python, SOAR workflows, and other scripting methods to reduce manual effort and improve response consistency.
* Develop and maintain security baselines, hardening standards, deployment playbooks, operational guides, and technical documentation.
* Monitor emerging threats, threat intelligence, and adversary techniques to adapt detections and controls based on current attack trends.
* Provide technical leadership, coaching, and mentorship to junior engineers, SOC analysts, and cross\-functional teams.
  

  

Technical Responsibilities


* Engineer, deploy, and administer EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, including policy tuning, threat detection, response actions, and control validation.
* Implement and manage SIEM platforms such as CrowdStrike NG SIEM or Splunk, including log onboarding, parsing, normalization, dashboarding, and advanced correlation logic.
* Design, implement, and support IDS/IPS and network security monitoring solutions to improve threat visibility, prevention, and investigation capability.
* Administer and optimize Microsoft 365 Security capabilities, including Microsoft Defender Suite, Entra ID, Conditional Access, Secure Score improvements, and identity protection controls.

* Implement of identity security controls, including MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access controls, least privilege, and Zero Trust principles.
* Build and maintain SOC automation and SOAR workflows for incident triage, evidence collection, containment actions, enrichment, notification, and reporting.
* Integrate and manage threat intelligence feeds across security tools to support proactive detection, enrichment, and threat hunting.
* Perform log source integration across servers, endpoints, network devices, cloud platforms, firewalls, identity systems, and business\-critical applications.
* Support compliance and audit activities, including HIPAA, NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS\-aligned evidence gathering, configuration review, reporting, and technical control validation.
  

  

Required Skills and Experience


* Strong hands\-on experience in security engineering, control implementation, and enterprise security tool deployment.
* Proven expertise in incident detection, incident response, alert tuning, threat hunting, and SOC enablement.
* Experience with firewalls, endpoint protection, cloud security controls, identity controls, and Microsoft security ecosystems.
* Working knowledge of scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, or similar languages.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex multi\-layer security issues across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and application environments.
* Strong understanding of modern attack techniques, adversary behaviors, MITRE ATT\&CK framework, and detection engineering principles.
* Experience working in fast\-paced SOC, security engineering, or enterprise security operations environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, technical leadership, prioritization, and project execution skills.
  

  

Required Qualifications


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in IT Security, including at least 5\+ years in security engineering, implementation, or platform administration roles.
* Hands\-on experience with EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, MDM, Microsoft 365 Security, IAM/PAM, vulnerability management, and cloud security controls.
* Strong understanding of security frameworks and benchmarks, including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and CIS Benchmarks.
